result.title: ProxySearch: Decoupled Inference-Time Scaling for Diffusion Models via Asymmetric Noise-Rank Transfer
result.summary: Noise search at inference time improves text-to-image diffusion but requires many multi-step teacher rollouts per query. Distilled few-step models are now routinely released, yet their potential as proxies inside noise search is uncharacterized. We measure proxy-teacher rank agreement across three distillation regimes and three backbones (DiT, MMDiT, UNet) and find a sharp asymmetry. On our main pool, closed-form image statistics transfer from the proxy to the teacher (Spearman $ρ$ up to 0.80), while learned semantic scorers do not ($ρ\le$ 0.12). Paired null controls trace this rank to the first denoising step for coarse statistics and to distillation for finer ones. We use the asymmetry for noise search under a joint constraint: a semantic reward specifies content, and a numeric target specifies image statistics. In PROXYSEARCH, the proxy filters candidates by statistical match in 1 step, and the teacher returns the survivor with the highest semantic reward. No weight trades one objective against the other. On FLUX-1024, PROXYSEARCH tightens the statistical target by 21-23% at the same number of teacher trajectories, with no detected loss on the optimized reward.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察少步蒸馏扩散模型作为「代理」在推理期噪声搜索中的排序一致性，发现代理到教师的可迁移性存在明显不对称：统计量可迁移而语义评分不可；据此设计 PROXYSEARCH，用代理一步筛选统计匹配候选、再由教师按语义奖励选优。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「廉价代理先筛、昂贵教师后评」的不对称排序迁移可供核查：能否作为 LVR 中候选 latent 轨迹的轻量预筛与计算/停止分配线索，但该文属图像生成搜索，与 VLM 推理状态的对应关系尚不确定。
